top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation is a new chemical principle (event-driven, catalytic removal by induced proximity to an E3 ligase) reproduced widely. Crews and Deshaies conceived the PROTAC concept, and Handa's identification of cereblon explains the thalidomide-type glues already in approved drugs, which answers the maturity objection. One citation covering both E3-recruitment mechanisms gives a coherent achievement in three names. P001 (Ciulli instead of Handa) is a close second but leaves the clinically proven strand outside the citation.
